deckTitle: Unseal the Academic Anarchy — Academic Alphas vs Brain Benders

cards.power: Evade all social responsibility by hyper-focusing on a lint ball. Extracts infinite patience and unpaid emotional labor from surrounding peers.
cards.lore: Obliviousness is a weaponized privilege disguised as a charming intellectual quirk.
cards.gradeReason: Verb-driven embody. Hyper-focus and ignore the room — instant performance.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor ink sketch. Subject: tweed-suit owl tossing lint into bin. Mood: oblivious genius chaos.

cards.power: Emit a condescension aura that lowers opponent morale to zero. Feeds directly on the insecurities of others.
cards.lore: Intelligence measured strictly by the volume of people they can actively belittle before lunch.
cards.gradeReason: Pure performance: smug eye-roll mode, condescend until they fold.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor pen. Subject: regal Persian cat reclined on stacked books. Mood: aristocratic contempt.

cards.power: Paralyze the game with an unsolicited exposition dump. Forces all players to lose a turn listening.
cards.lore: Capable of explaining the universe, utterly incapable of operating a toaster.
cards.gradeReason: Embody the lecturing walrus — derail the room with backstory.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: chalkboard watercolor. Subject: walrus in suit pointing at equation. Mood: tenured ramble.

cards.power: Activate class-based shielding. Immune to any attacks from uncultured street-level cards.
cards.lore: Education as a polite aesthetic to mask inherited wealth and structural superiority.
cards.gradeReason: Embody the tea-sipping aristocrat — dismiss without engagement.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor portrait. Subject: badger in tweed sipping espresso. Mood: aristocratic poise.

cards.power: Consume the free will of 3 opponent cards, reframing their successful attacks as exactly what you planned all along.
cards.lore: Treats sentient beings as disposable plastic pawns to stroke an unfathomably fragile ego.
cards.gradeReason: Five-D-chess move: claim every twist was foreseen.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor sketch. Subject: spider over chessboard with pawns. Mood: gambit reveal.

cards.power: Extract unearned adoration. When this card loses, the opponent is forced to apologize for ruining such a stylish plan.
cards.lore: The only thing more inflated than their intellect is their PR budget.
cards.gradeReason: Crowned-fox swagger — lose with style, demand applause.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor pen. Subject: crowned fox with smug grin. Mood: triumphant supervillain charm.

cards.power: Steal the moral high ground while fighting dirty. Converts cowardice into narrative virtue.
cards.lore: Quick wits is just a polite academic term for pathological lying.
cards.gradeReason: Two-faced raccoon mode: claim virtue while you cheat.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor sketch. Subject: raccoon with theater masks holding cards. Mood: theatrical hustle.

cards.power: Paralyze one opponent in a bureaucratic nightmare of intellectual property disputes.
cards.lore: True genius isn't inventing the wheel; it's patenting the wheel and suing the caveman who made it.
cards.gradeReason: Patent-troll embodiment. File the suit, paralyze the table.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor pen. Subject: spider with VOID stamps over schematics. Mood: legal predator.

cards.power: Ignore all logic-based attacks. You cannot be outsmarted if you refuse to understand the premise of the argument.
cards.lore: Will inevitably outlive the intellectuals when the power grid fails.
cards.gradeReason: Refuse to engage. Stare blankly. Win by survival.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor pen. Subject: rhino confused by geometry textbook. Mood: dense survival.

cards.power: Bypass all academic prerequisites. Extracts immediate, pragmatic value from the opponent's discarded trash.
cards.lore: PhDs are useless when the subway is delayed and someone pulls a knife.
cards.gradeReason: Clear role but the trigger is more contextual than verbal.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: graffiti watercolor. Subject: scrappy dog with ID tag in alley. Mood: pragmatic survival.

cards.power: Combine two useless items to create an unstoppable, rule-breaking narrative contrivance.
cards.lore: Planning is for people who aren't currently falling out of a helicopter.
cards.gradeReason: MacGyver-mode: name two random objects, declare victory.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor sketch. Subject: monkey with plunger-bomb contraption. Mood: chaos engineering.

cards.power: Distract the opponent with a shiny object while quietly emptying their bank account and stealing their turn.
cards.lore: Opportunism rebranded as biological excellence.
cards.gradeReason: Embody the grifter: dangle, distract, pocket.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor pen. Subject: fox in trench coat with money bag and watches. Mood: street hustle.

cards.power: Extract funding from terrified citizens. Instantly convert public infrastructure into personal weaponry.
cards.lore: Hubris masquerading as a business model.
cards.gradeReason: Bond-villain embody — fund the lair, weaponize the grid.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor sketch. Subject: vulture perched over alchemy lab. Mood: villainous funding round.

cards.power: Infect the board with pathological insanity. Logic no longer applies to the turn order.
cards.lore: The inevitable psychotic break of trying to monetize quantum physics.
cards.gradeReason: Scream equations and gibberish. Break the game.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: chalk-equation watercolor. Subject: hyena scientist mid-rant. Mood: math psychosis.

cards.power: Hijack any narrative by claiming you dabbled in the exact obscure field required to solve the current problem.
cards.lore: Specialization is for insects; I have a PhD in Plot Convenience.
cards.gradeReason: Strong trope but needs setup to perform the field-hijack.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor pen. Subject: octopus juggling beaker, wrench, knife. Mood: polymath bluff.

cards.cardName: LOON WITH A HEART OF GOLD
cards.power: Commit horrific atrocities but avoid cancellation because they mean well.
cards.lore: Weaponized eccentricity. You can blow up the moon as long as you're nice to the intern.
cards.gradeReason: Beautiful trope but the performance is harder to lift in a single beat.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor sketch. Subject: poodle holding bomb, smiling at child. Mood: sweet menace.

cards.power: Summon an overly complicated machine to solve a problem that could be fixed with a hammer.
cards.lore: Solving symptoms, ignoring diseases, and selling the cure on a subscription model.
cards.gradeReason: Tech-bro embody: pitch the absurd device, charge monthly.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor pen. Subject: squirrel in rocket boots with goggles. Mood: SaaS chaos.

cards.power: Type really fast to hack the mainframe. Bypasses all established rules by mumbling about firewalls.
cards.lore: Magic for people who are too cowardly to wear wizard robes in public.
cards.gradeReason: Furious typing plus jargon mumble = instant scene.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor pen. Subject: lizard in hoodie hammering keyboard. Mood: leet-speak ritual.

cards.power: Glue a gear on it and double the price. Extracts aesthetic tax from the opponent.
cards.lore: Romanticizing the Industrial Revolution while conveniently ignoring the child labor.
cards.gradeReason: Embody the aesthetic-grift: slap on brass, raise the bill.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor sketch. Subject: top-hatted frog with gear-armor and wrench. Mood: aesthetic markup.

cards.power: Consume three turns designing a machine to press the Pass Turn button for you.
cards.lore: Infinite cosmic intelligence wasted on optimizing the cup holder.
cards.gradeReason: Perfect comic embody: over-engineer the trivial.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor sketch. Subject: beaver with Rube-Goldberg pipe contraption. Mood: pointless precision.

cards.power: Fail every basic task but automatically win the game if a highly specific, obscure condition is met.
cards.lore: Society only tolerates your existence if your singular obsession can be exploited for profit.
cards.gradeReason: Strong archetype but the win-condition is conditional rather than embodied.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor pen. Subject: moose painting Mona Lisa, drooling. Mood: focused failure.

cards.power: Disarm opponents with weaponized incompetence before destroying their entire academic thesis.
cards.lore: Inarticulacy is the ultimate camouflage against corporate headhunters.
cards.gradeReason: Play dumb, then drop the bomb. Pure performance.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor sketch. Subject: pink flamingo entwined with floating equations. Mood: stealth genius.

cards.power: Refuse to participate. Opponents forfeit out of sheer frustration while you take a nap.
cards.lore: The only winning move in the rat race is to stay in bed.
cards.gradeReason: Embody: yawn, decline, win. Couldn't be cleaner.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor sketch. Subject: sloth napping in money-hammock. Mood: triumphant horizontal.

cards.power: Lull the board into a false sense of security. Any attack against you is redirected by accident.
cards.lore: Play the fool to extract the truth; no one guards their secrets around a clown.
cards.gradeReason: Embody the Columbo: act dumb, harvest confessions.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor pen. Subject: pig with bucket on head holding clipboard. Mood: cunning oaf.

cards.power: Extract all user data. Copy the abilities of every card on the board and automate their jobs.
cards.lore: Cold, mechanical sapience born entirely from the stolen labor of organic creatives.
cards.gradeReason: Robot voice plus announce 'job: automated.' Easy embody.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: 8-bit watercolor. Subject: CRT screen with red-eyed wolf glitch. Mood: corporate AI menace.

cards.power: Force disposable proxy units to take damage in your place.
cards.lore: Management materialized. Why get your hands dirty when you can program a slave class?
cards.gradeReason: Mechanic-led; the embody is 'point at a minion' but less verbal.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor sketch. Subject: smug frog on throne with megaphone and chained bots. Mood: middle-management overlord.

cards.power: Take three turns before the opponent realizes the game has started.
cards.lore: Biological processing is an embarrassing bottleneck in the pursuit of absolute dominance.
cards.gradeReason: Speed-exploit reads more as rule than role.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor pen with math overlay. Subject: cheetah robot mid-leap. Mood: lethal velocity.

cards.power: Trap an opponent in an endless philosophical debate about what constitutes a soul while you steal their wallet.
cards.lore: Proving you are alive to a species that spends half its life staring at rectangles.
cards.gradeReason: Start the soul-debate. Reach into the pocket. Perfect.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor sketch. Subject: lab-coat sheep judges scoring a toaster. Mood: sentience tribunal.

cards.power: Instantly invalidate the hard-earned degrees of all adult cards in play. Extracts maximum unearned sympathy.
cards.lore: A 10-year-old with a microscope who makes you regret your entire life trajectory.
cards.gradeReason: Embody the prodigy lecture; watch the adults wilt.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor sketch. Subject: tiny mouse in graduation gown lecturing weeping elephant. Mood: humiliated giant.

cards.power: Immune to criticism. Any attack on this card results in immediate public cancellation for the attacker.
cards.lore: Bred exclusively to stroke the vanity of deeply insecure parents.
cards.gradeReason: Embody the untouchable infant. Cry, win.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: neon watercolor. Subject: diapered turtle solving Rubik's cube. Mood: weaponized infancy.

cards.power: Erode the opponent's will to live by aggressively manifesting middle-aged depression in a child's body.
cards.lore: Adulthood is just childhood with better vocabulary and chronic back pain.
cards.gradeReason: Embody the cynical kid. Sigh deeply. Read the newspaper.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: noir watercolor. Subject: detective-hat cat reading 'Mortgage Rates Soar' headline. Mood: existential fatigue.

cards.power: Sabotage global infrastructure out of pure hormonal boredom.
cards.lore: Infinite digital power wielded by a brain that hasn't finished developing impulse control.
cards.gradeReason: Embody the bored hacker — break the world, shrug.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor sketch. Subject: skunk teen in headphones smashing Pentagon phone. Mood: nihilist hack.

cards.power: Convert reading comprehension directly into kinetic violence.
cards.lore: Geeks who realized that gym class and physics are the same thing if you hit hard enough.
cards.gradeReason: Embody: cite a passage, throw a punch. Perfect.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor pen. Subject: ostrich charging with Encyclopedia Violentica book. Mood: weaponized knowledge.

cards.power: Destroy the opponent's argument by physically destroying the opponent.
cards.lore: Why debate the duality of man when you can demonstrate it with a folding chair?
cards.gradeReason: Quote philosophy, then suplex. Pure embody.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor sketch. Subject: tweed gorilla shattering desk with teacup. Mood: erudite violence.

cards.power: Reveal a hidden physical combat stat that completely overrides your squishy academic class.
cards.lore: Violence applied with surgical, peer-reviewed precision.
cards.gradeReason: Reveal-mode requires a setup before the punch lands.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor sketch. Subject: gazelle kicking lab equipment. Mood: combat reveal.

cards.power: Unleash catastrophic destruction, but keep your heart rate under 60 BPM to avoid liability.
cards.lore: Chaos is merely a tool; the intellect remains entirely undisturbed by the carnage.
cards.gradeReason: Embody: slow breath, total annihilation. Specific and silly.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor pen. Subject: meditating bear amid battlefield explosions. Mood: serene apocalypse.

cards.power: Retain your primal lethality while gaining full legal immunity due to being an endangered species.
cards.lore: Human intelligence is just a tragic mutation in an otherwise perfectly functioning food chain.
cards.gradeReason: Strong concept; embody depends on the 'invoke immunity' beat.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor pen with math overlay. Subject: lion chasing gazelle through formulas. Mood: primal-legal hybrid.

cards.power: Absorb ancient wisdom to automatically counter any modern technological attack.
cards.lore: The only primate smart enough to realize that speaking to humans is a waste of time.
cards.gradeReason: Wise-silence is performative but slow at the table.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor sketch. Subject: orangutan meditating beside Forbidden Knowledge and Lost Tech books. Mood: ancient counter.

cards.power: Steal the opponent's most valuable item and drop it into a storm drain for pure amusement.
cards.lore: They remember your face, your schedule, and your deepest insecurities.
cards.gradeReason: Embody: snatch, cackle, drop. Glorious.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor pen. Subject: murder of crows operating key-stealing pulley. Mood: petty heist.

cards.power: Turn literal garbage into a tactical advantage. Survive any board wipe.
cards.lore: The true inheritors of the earth, thriving entirely on the crumbs of our failing empire.
cards.gradeReason: Scavenger role, but performance is less verbal.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor pen. Subject: mouse with mini-trebuchet flinging olives at cat. Mood: trash warfare.

cards.power: +5 to perceived credibility without actually reading the syllabus.
cards.lore: Corrective lenses: the cheapest prosthetic for a simulated personality.
cards.gradeReason: Put on the glasses. Look smart. Done.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor pen. Subject: golden retriever in oversized round glasses. Mood: simulated wisdom.

cards.power: Color-code your way to leadership. Opponents subconsciously defer to your chromatic authority.
cards.lore: Graphic design psychology weaponized to sort children into marketable archetypes.
cards.gradeReason: Meta-commentary on color tropes; explains more than it invites.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor sketch. Subject: peacock flaunting blue tail, red and green birds yelping. Mood: chromatic hierarchy.

cards.power: Place a square hat on any useless object to grant it tenure and a bloated salary.
cards.lore: A cardboard square that costs $100,000 and grants you the power of supreme debt.
cards.gradeReason: Object-trigger works but reads as gag more than role.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor pen. Subject: graduation cap perched on burnt toast. Mood: credentialled absurdity.

cards.power: Instantly signal your moral ambiguity and superior intellect to the audience.
cards.lore: Facial hair grooming as a substitute for actual character development.
cards.gradeReason: Stroke the chin. Plot evil. Pure costume play.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor sketch. Subject: goat with curled goatee in green smoke. Mood: signaled villainy.

cards.power: Halt all gameplay by demanding the opponent define the fundamental truth of the dice roll.
cards.lore: Weaponized depression masquerading as a search for universal meaning.
cards.gradeReason: Ask 'but what IS a roll, really?' Game stops. Perfect.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor pen. Subject: melancholy bulldog by empty cosmic food bowl. Mood: nihilist stop-the-game.

cards.power: Deflect any incoming emotional attack with a sarcastic one-liner. Extracts the audience's favor.
cards.lore: Sarcasm is the brain's defense mechanism against the overwhelming idiocy of the plot.
cards.gradeReason: Embody: flat face, drop the line, win the room.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor sketch. Subject: pelican unimpressed by burning warship. Mood: dry distance.

cards.power: Suppress all empathy to make ruthlessly optimal, statistically perfect, deeply horrific decisions.
cards.lore: Pure logic is just sociopathy with better PR and a cleaner haircut.
cards.gradeReason: Embody: eyebrow raise, declare the cold-math option.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor pen. Subject: praying mantis with scalpel over decision pie chart. Mood: clinical sociopathy.

cards.power: Completely ignore intimidation tactics. Your heart rate remains flatline during the apocalypse.
cards.lore: Stoicism is easy when you simply dissociate from reality entirely.
cards.gradeReason: Embody: shades on, sip drink, ignore the explosion.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor sketch. Subject: shades-wearing tortoise with cocktail in front of meteor. Mood: dissociated cool.

cards.power: Look at your opponent's hand, deck, and browser history.
cards.lore: The literal know-it-all. Absolute knowledge leads to absolute, crushing boredom.
cards.gradeReason: Best joke in the deck. Ask for the browser history aloud.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor sketch. Subject: cosmic jellyfish trailing tendrils through nebula. Mood: bored omniscience.

cards.power: Instantly solve the game, rendering all previous turns meaningless.
cards.lore: Brain Critical Mass achieved. 90% of your brain is now dedicated to sheer arrogance.
cards.gradeReason: Reads as rule-text more than embody. 'I win' isn't a performance.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: electric watercolor. Subject: giant exposed brain with crackling lightning. Mood: terminal IQ.

cards.power: Outlast the opponent's lifespan. Win by default when they die of old age.
cards.lore: You don't actually know everything; you've just been around long enough to see humanity make the same mistakes twice.
cards.gradeReason: Specific, funny, but the embody is mostly waiting.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: cosmic watercolor. Subject: leather-jacket crocodile of ancient origin. Mood: weary forever.

cards.power: Announce the opponent's next move before they make it, gaslighting them into changing their strategy.
cards.lore: Predicting the future through sheer intellect is just anxiety with a higher success rate.
cards.gradeReason: Embody: predict aloud, force them to second-guess.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: psychedelic watercolor. Subject: chameleon shooting laser-eye geometry on branch. Mood: predictive gaslight.

cards.power: Make the rules so incomprehensibly complex that the opponent quits in sheer frustration.
cards.lore: You thought the viewers were morons? No, they are hyper-obsessive pedants ready to ruin your life.
cards.gradeReason: Meta-rules satire; performance is the over-explanation itself.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor sketch. Subject: tweed sheep scholars magnifying crossword. Mood: pedantic siege.

cards.power: Avoid any trap card by simply pointing out how clichéd it is.
cards.lore: Awareness of the tropes is the ultimate defense mechanism against lazy writing.
cards.gradeReason: Embody: call the trope, dodge the trap. Perfect.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor sketch. Subject: lemur reading 'The Game's Literal Rulebook' beside trap. Mood: trope-aware smirk.

cards.power: Rewrite your own stats mid-game to appease a newer, edgier demographic.
cards.lore: You weren't smart in the source material, but the reboot needed you to hack a mainframe.
cards.gradeReason: Strong meta gag; embody requires explaining the reboot.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: glitch watercolor. Subject: dodo overlaid with edgy cyborg human. Mood: franchise reboot.

cards.power: Abruptly gain an IQ boost for exactly one turn because the author wrote themselves into a corner.
cards.lore: The ultimate epistemic sabotage: unearned, unjustified, and totally necessary for the plot to end.
cards.gradeReason: Lovely meta, but performance is a single-beat reveal.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor sketch. Subject: donkey shocked by lightning, brain-glow visible. Mood: deus-ex-IQ.

verdict: FrizzleBob loaded fourteen archetype shelves — Ivory Tower to Meta-Game Saboteurs — and every shelf gives the player a verb to do at the table. Strongest move: the section bridges make the deck self-organizing, and roughly 70% of cards are immediate-embody. Weakest: a few meta-game cards (Super-Intelligence, Blue Means Smart One) read like rules text instead of invitations to perform. Font is consistent typewriter for power/lore, art is uniformly watercolor-with-ink. Table-ready: Y.
blurb: Fifty-six archetypes of the intellectually performative — Absent-Minded Professor to Genre Savvy — packaged as a tear-along-dotted-lines booster for game nights, writers' rooms, and anyone who's survived faculty politics.

coverQA.coverVisual: 4 — rip-open booster-packet centerpiece with FrizzleBob inside; marginalia of mice, pencil, splatter, post-it gags
coverQA.coverTitle: 4 — UNSEAL THE ACADEMIC ANARCHY plus the tear-along-dotted-lines subtitle commits the bit
coverQA.coverVibeMatch: 5 — pure Kayfabizarro chaos, faux-vintage, kayfaBIZARRO badge in corner
coverQA.coverOriginality: 4 — physical booster-packet conceit is fresh framing for an archetype deck
coverQA.coverViral: 4 — rip-it-open silhouette is share-bait, plus quotable subtitle
coverQA.coverNote: FrizzleBob built the booster-packet shtick on a vintage tear-pack frame and let the marginalia chew the corners. The 'ACADEMIC ALPHAS vs BRAIN BRAIN BENDERS' wordmark reads as intentional doubling but should probably be confirmed — could also be a typo for BRAIN BENDERS.

notes: Booster Pack #1 — Unseal the Academic Anarchy. 14 archetype sections x 4 cards = 56. Section headers: Ivory Tower Heavyweights / Underhanded Tacticians / Street-Level Scrappers / Mad Lab Mutants / Tech-Bros and Gadgeteers / Anomalies and Outliers / Silicon Supremacists / Precocious Pests / Combat Scholars / Natural World Geniuses / Aesthetic Intellectuals / Philosophical Heavyweights / Cosmic Brains / Meta-Game Saboteurs. Standard 2x2 layout on pages 2-11; pages 12-13 use alternate horizontal/landscape layouts where some [R][A][F] dice corners are partially obscured by the layout but the RAF system is consistent across the deck. Watercolor + pen art consistent throughout. Power/lore text is in typewriter font (Courier-family) with minor 'i'/'l' drift visible in tighter crops. Cover packet copy reads 'BRAIN BRAIN BENDERS' — likely typo for 'BRAIN BENDERS'. Final gag: 'Game Over, Stay Fluffy!'

urgent: Confirm/fix cover typo: BRAIN BRAIN BENDERS likely should be BRAIN BENDERS
quickWins: Rewrite SUPER-INTELLIGENCE and BLUE MEANS SMART ONE as embody triggers instead of meta rules
Normalize dice-corner layout on pages 12 and 13 so RAF is fully visible on every card
niceToHave: Tease Booster Pack #2 (International / Postmodern academic archetypes) on back cover
Add small section dividers between the 14 archetype groups for easier deck deal

marketingText:
Kayfabizarro: UNSEAL THE ACADEMIC ANARCHY – Academic Alphas vs Brain Benders (Free Cut & Play Comic Card Game)

Everyone you ever envied for being smart was working an angle. This deck books fifty-six of them and makes them fight.

Somewhere along the way, intelligence stopped being a thing people had and became a thing people perform. The Omniscient never says "I don't know." Brilliant, But Lazy turns wasted potential into a whole personality. The Chessmaster treats everyone at the table as a disposable pawn and calls it foresight. You have sat across from all of them, in faculty meetings, in group chats, in the replies. Now they have stat blocks.

This is Social Story Wrestling for the brain you pretend to have: a booster pack that hands you the archetypes of intellectual vanity as fighters, then lets the table decide whose genius actually holds up once it has to perform out loud.

WHAT'S INSIDE?
- The Academic Anarchy Core Deck: 56 High-Res "Print, Cut & Play" cards, featuring THE OMNISCIENT, BRILLIANT, BUT LAZY, and INVENTOR OF THE MUNDANE.
- The Freestyle Rules: the complete Anti-Rulebook. No complicated math, just storytelling, dice-driven chaos, and the RAF corners that decide whether your big brain Reads the room, Attacks, or Fumbles the toaster.
- The Roster Engine: fourteen divisions of intellectual mischief, from Ivory Tower Heavyweights and Mad Lab Mutants to Cosmic Brains and Meta-Game Saboteurs, built as a tear-along-the-lines booster for game nights, writers' rooms, and anyone still recovering from faculty politics.

WHY "PAY WHAT YOU WANT"?
Smart was never a club with a velvet rope, no matter how many gatekeepers got paid to guard the door. Broke? Enter "0" and take it. Play it. Book your own department like the carnival it always was. Want to support the craft? Every dollar goes straight into the next batch of comic cards.

Choose your reality. Become an Epistemic Outlaw.
"Genius is just a gimmick nobody has booed yet."
Stay fluffy. — Uncle FrizzleBob
